entry.title: Millennium Falcon: Turbojet to Ramjet
entry.summary: An interactive propulsion demo: click to set a target Mach and a freighter accelerates on an afterburning turbojet, then hands its inlet over to a ramjet between Mach 2 and 3.

entry.title: Droid Arm Reach
entry.summary: An interactive manipulator demo: click and a droid's arm plans a smooth straight-line reach, solving inverse kinematics on the fly and using computed-torque control to follow it.

entry.title: Death Star Orbit & Attitude
entry.summary: An interactive orbit and attitude demo: click to pick a new orbit and the Death Star flies a two-burn Hohmann transfer, slewing with a reaction wheel to point its engine before each burn.

entry.title: X-Wing Path Following
entry.summary: An interactive demo of Beard & McLain path following and path management: an X-wing flies a waypoint loop with straight lines, fillets or Dubins paths.

entry.title: Hogwarts Pedagogy
entry.summary: What if you could wave a magic wand and learn twice as much in all your classes? Well, muggle, you can.
